'''Let's Make an Exploration Party!''' (Japanese: '''たんけんたいをつくろう！''' ''Tankentai o Tsukurou!'') is one of the opening songs of the Japanese [[Pikachu short]]s; first debuting in ''[[PK04|Pikachu Expedition]]''.
